gen-fs-bevellier-gf-graduate: Graduate reads dignified and bookish, a classic serif with generous gaps between letters and capitals that barely tower over the lowercase. And Bevellier above it cuts flat, stencil-like strokes set tight together, so the two feel like different rooms in one library.
gen-fs-bevellier-noto-serif: Bevellier draws a flat, stencil-cut heading where even the w has no thick or thin strokes, while Noto Serif below it is softer. Its pencil-line taper tires over many paragraphs.
gen-fs-bevellier-poppins: Poppins reads modern and clean, with loose curves and sturdy tall lowercase. Bevellier does its best work up top, cutting flat and graceful letters tightly together, while the sans below keeps every stroke smooth and unfussy.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-hind: Hind reads like a drawn string, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its c endings never curling inward. Bonny handles the headline flourish.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-literata: Refined is the word for Bonny, a serif whose curves gape and whose strokes vary just moderately in weight. Literata brings the same bookish build, with sturdy thin lines and wide, unclosed mouths on its round letters.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-synonym: Bonny gives the heading a smooth, modest weight gradient. Synonym lays down a plain sans stripe of constant ink with generous openings, so a long passage moves along like a quiet, dependable road.
gen-fs-bonny-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads compact and modern, its characters standing like pins in a wide board. Bonny earns its keep big and short, where its shifting stroke widths and gaping curves can be noticed.
gen-fs-bonny-gf-orbit: Literary Bonny sets tight lines with moderately modulated strokes and curves that gape. Orbit brings a plain sans counterpart, each character floating apart, so give it a little more size than feels necessary.
gen-fs-bonny-inter: Literary and refined, Bonny shows a calm thick-thin difference and a moderate lowercase height. And Inter, drawn like a laser-etched line with big counters, carries a longer passage in a smooth, tube-like flow.
gen-fs-bonny-manrope: Refined Bonny lets light modulation ripple through its strokes, with gaping curves and tight-set lines. But Manrope's bright openings and drawn-string steadiness give the pair its strongest quality: a gentle shift from literary to approachable.
